subject: Re: Request: trial window & sandbox credits due to integration sprint delay (MatrixWare)
messages:
From: Alex Sutton <alex.sutton@matrixware.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Trial pause: integration sprint hit — asking for extension and credits

Hi Rafael,

Quick note from our side — we hit an unexpected blocker in the MatrixWare connector while toggling SAML in our staging cluster. The engineering sprint that was meant to finish the adaptor work is slipping by ~3 weeks because the identity team discovered a schema mismatch with our customer directory provider.

We still want to move forward with the Redwood pilot (we like the latency numbers we saw in the demo), but we need a little runway. Can you help with a 30-day trial extension and some sandbox credits to keep the proof-of-concept running while our devs clear the blocker? I attached the error log and a short form the procurement team asked us to fill out.

What would be the quickest path to approval for that?

Thanks,
Alex Sutton
Head of Product, MatrixWare
alex.sutton@matrixware.com
[Attachment: integration_error_log.txt (text)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Sutton <alex.sutton@matrixware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial pause: integration sprint hit — asking for extension and credits

Alex — thanks for the heads up and for the log. Sorry to hear about the SAML schema surprise.

Short answer: we can usually approve a 30-day extension and a discretionary sandbox credit top-up for engineering stalls like this, but I need to confirm with the accounts team for the dollar amount. Can you confirm two quick items for me so I can move this internally?

- Which environment is blocked (staging vs. preprod vs. customer sandbox)?
- Rough estimate: how many tokens / calls do you expect the team to need over the next 30 days (so I can size credits)?

If you prefer, Marissa (cc'd) can step in on the credit side. I’ll also flag this to legal/procurement if you want a short form we fill out for auditing.

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cell: (415) 555-0148

From: Alex Sutton <alex.sutton@matrixware.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: MatrixWare Engineering <eng@matrixware.com>, Procurement <procurement@matrixware.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial pause: integration sprint hit — asking for extension and credits

Thanks Rafael — details below:

- Environment: staging (we're keeping production isolated until SAML is stable)
- Usage estimate: team expects ~150k tokens/month for active debugging + 50k tokens for automated regression tests; say 200k tokens total for 30 days.

I've re-attached the procurement form filled out and included a short engineer note on the blocker. We can be flexible on the credit amount; the extension window is the higher priority.

Appreciate the quick help — can you loop in whoever needs to approve?

Alex
[Attachment: trial_extension_request_form.pdf]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Sutton <alex.sutton@matrixware.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: MatrixWare trial extension & credits request (docs attached)

Marissa / Dev — MatrixWare (DEAL-4931-MW) is asking for a 30-day trial extension and ~200k token-equivalent sandbox credits due to a staging SAML/schema blocker. Alex has provided the procurement form and logs (attached).

My ask: can we pre-authorize a $1,200 sandbox credit bucket (approx equivalent to 200k tokens at their current usage profile) and a 30-day extension on the trial window? They’re an active product team and showed good signal in the demo; this should keep momentum.

Notes:
- Region: us-west staging
- No PII is being sent to Redwood during the blocked tests (they confirmed).
- If we approve, I’ll update the HubSpot deal and copy procurement with a short approval memo.

Marissa — want me to put together a short approval note for you to sign off?

Rafael
[Attachment: integration_error_log.txt (text), trial_extension_request_form.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Internal: MatrixWare trial extension & credits request (docs attached)

Stephanie — forwarding this for quick approval. Rafael recommends $1.2k sandbox credit + 30-day extension. Dev, can you confirm there are no outstanding security flags on MatrixWare (I pulled the SOC2 summary last quarter but want a quick thumbs)?

If you're comfortable, please approve and I'll have Rafael update the deal and notify their procurement. Attaching a one-page credit-approval stub for signature.

Marissa
VP, Growth Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit-approval-note.pdf]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Internal: MatrixWare trial extension & credits request (docs attached)

Marissa / team — approved. Please apply a 30-day trial extension and $1,200 sandbox credit to DEAL-4931-MW. Dev: got your note — no open security flags on the last review. Rafael: please confirm the credit ticker and send a short email to MatrixWare (procurement cc'd) summarizing terms and the effective dates.

Stephaine Nguyen
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

---
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Sutton <alex.sutton@matrixware.com>, Procurement <procurement@matrixware.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Trial extension and sandbox credits approved (MatrixWare / DEAL-4931-MW)

Alex — good news: our Sales Ops team approved the request. Summary below and timeline: 

- Extension: 30 days (new trial expiration: 2027-01-04)
- Sandbox credits: $1,200 applied to the trial account (equivalent to ~200k tokens at your current profile)
- Effective immediately — credits and extension now reflected in the HubSpot deal and in your trial dashboard.

Attached is the short approval stub for your procurement records. No additional paperwork needed. If procurement still needs a signed document, let me know and I’ll route it.

Next steps:
- Rafael will check in with your engineer in 1 week to see if any runtime/SDK tweaks are needed (I’ve cc'd Dev Patel for technical support)
- If integration clears sooner, we can ramp the test suite back up and keep you posted on usage.

Thanks — and ping me if anything spikes.

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
